entities.summary: Johann Wilhelm Ludwig Gleim was a German poet, commonly associated with the Enlightenment and Rococo movements. Johann Wilhelm Ludwig Gleim was a poets & playwrights from Ermsleben (1719-04-02, Ermsleben–1803-02-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
